manual_checks: Read every page in visual order and compare all eight headings to declared order.

Count five visible bullet items and compare their order and sentence endings to the original source.
Compare unsorted extractor spans with the visual pages; record any divergence without asserting universal reading order.
Inspect all accent marks, dash substitutions, date ranges, gaps and clipping on every exported page.
Read the exported page in visual paragraph order, including repeated sender name and closing.
Check date, salutation and closing placement and their following/preceding paragraphs.
Compare Unicode, sentence endings, internal clipping and vertical gaps with the exact plain-text fixture.

Keep existing diagnostic skipped statuses for reading_order/orphaned_headings/visual_readability/internal_clipping/excessive_gaps; manual observations are a separate case-specific record.
